Read cda-separation/AGENTS.md and cda-separation/context/brief.md, and follow AGENTS.md.
The repos are not under repos/. CDWP is at <CDWP path> and CDW is at <CDW path>. Both are read only.

Every file you create (work/, deliverables/, context/ snapshots) goes inside cda-separation/, never inside the CDWP or CDW repos.
